= Overview =

Nearly all of the Spearhead 1944 assets can be retextured. There are two ways to do that that will be explained on this page.

= Retexturing =

[[File:spe hiddenSelections.gif|right|300px]]
The easiest way to retexture assets is with the commands [[setObjectTexture]] and [[setObjectTextureGlobal]]. This can be done with [[Procedural Textures]] or custom textures created. See [[Retexturing with setObjectTexture]] for more information.

To find out which assets support retexturing see the [[#Hidden Selections List|table]] below that lists all [[CfgVehicles_Config_Reference#hiddenSelections|hidden selections]].

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Code !! Result
|-
| <sqf>this setObjectTexture [0, "#(rgb,8,8,3)color(0.1,0.1,0.1,1,CO)"];</sqf> || [[File:spe retexture example 1.jpg|300px]]

|-
| <sqf>this setObjectTexture [0, "#(rgb,8,8,3)color(0.8,0.1,0.1,1,CO)"];</sqf> || [[File:spe retexture example 2.jpg|300px]]
|-
| <sqf>this setObjectTexture [0, "#(rgb,8,8,3)color(0.1,0.3,0.1,1,CO)"];
this setObjectTexture [1, "#(rgb,8,8,3)color(0.1,0.3,0.1,1,CO)"];
this setObjectTexture [2, "#(rgb,8,8,3)color(0.1,0.3,0.1,1,CO)"];</sqf>|| [[File:spe retexture example 3.jpg|300px]]
|}

Notice how dirt and wear textures are still visible even after changing the original texture.

= Retexturing Templates =

In order to help the community create their own custom textures, the Spearhead 1944 development team has prepared texture templates for infantry gear such as backpacks, headgear, vests and uniforms.

See the following tutorial to find out how to modify the textures in Photoshop.

{{Youtube|xcQ1RtHRc8I|||300px}}


[[File:FFI Equipment.jpg|left|300px]] [[File:GER M40 Offizier Feldanzug.jpg|300px]] [[File:GER Webgear Equipment.jpg|300px]] [[File:US M1 Helmet.jpg|300px]]
